name: XXL-JOB Console
description: Manage XXL-JOB tasks, logs and executors with DBX built-in AI and MCP, scoped permissions and confirmed operation previews.
releaseNotes: 0.4.3 declares MCP tool access levels in the plugin manifest so external MCP tools are visible again on DBX hosts that require tools/access (fixes undeclared tools). Keeps 2.2.x/2.3.x/3.4.x/3.5.x profiles, scoped permissions and preview-confirmed writes. Requires DBX 0.6.43+ and Host API ^1.4.0.
